ledger.com/mojang/authlib/GameProfile: authlib 7.0.61 made GameProfile a final record (javap: public final class com.mojang.authlib.GameProfile extends java.lang.Record): a mod subclass cannot load on 1.21.9, and an object of any other class cannot reach 1.21.9 code typed GameProfile (vanilla takes and returns the record everywhere: player profiles, skulls, the profile cache), so no facade can stand in for one. Covers the subclass's overrides of getId/getName/getProperties (calls are renamed to id/name/properties) and of equals/hashCode/toString (final in the record)
